meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给口播、访谈或播客视频叠上跟随字幕出现的动态图形卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一段口播或访谈素材,想让它看起来更精致、信息更清楚
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a talking-head or interview clip and want it to look sharper and clearer

howto.what: 把已有的口播、访谈或播客视频叠上按时序出现的图形卡片——标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画,卡片与转录对齐,原视频画面保持不动,最后渲染成一个 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等词,或想把视频包装起来时触发。只做普通字幕请走 /embedded-captions,拿不准先看 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这段口播视频包装一下,叠加图形卡片
say.note: 先转写,再规划卡片时序

say.text: 给这段访谈加下三分之一和数据标注,输出 9:16
把卡片换成 noir 主题,画布改成 4:5
say.note: 主题与画布随合成参数走

howto.what_en: Layers timed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP — onto an existing talking-head, interview or podcast clip, synced to the transcript, then renders one MP4. The clip itself plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics" or ask to package/dress up a video. Plain subtitles go to /embedded-captions; unsure → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Package this talking-head clip with graphic overlay cards
say_en.note: It transcribes first, then plans card timing

say_en.text: Add lower-thirds and data callouts to this interview, 9:16
Switch the cards to the noir theme and a 4:5 canvas
say_en.note: Theme and canvas follow composition settings
